Marissa — quick internal note:

Can you set the calendar invite timezone explicitly to Europe/Paris (or CET) and include the UTC time in the description? We've seen customers' calendars auto-shift when invites are created in the sender's local TZ. Since the offset is changing for a few weeks (US already on DST), anchoring to a Europe timezone prevents accidental one-hour shifts for EU attendees.

Thanks — J.
